mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, measurement_type, measurement_id, severity, message, status FROM t_health_alert WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_health_alert (user_id, measurement_type, measurement_id, severity, message, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{measurementType}, #{measurementId}, #{severity}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_health_alert SET user_id=#{userId}, measurement_type=#{measurementType}, measurement_id=#{measurementId}, severity=#{severity}, message=#{message}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
